author: Inside Edition
description: Terrifying video shows a young boy on an e-bike targeted by a driver who seemed determined to run him over. Jennifer Taylor, the boy's mom, spoke with Inside Edition. Witnesses say Wendy Clemente mounted the sidewalk and sped after him. Police also allege that Clemente tried to break into someone's house. She was charged with DUI, attempted second-degree assault and criminal trespass.
title: Video Shows Driver Appearing To Chase Teen On Dirt Bike

author: Inside Edition
description: New Hampshire Governor Kelly Ayotte and a state trooper rescued a driver trapped inside a car after it crashed into a highway toll booth. The governor grabbed a fire extinguisher from her car and went to work on the blaze while the trooper and other brave passers-by broke a window and pulled the driver through. The trapped driver was 50-year-old comedian Eugene Mirman, who voices the goofy kid Gene Belcher in the "Bob's Burgers" animated series that airs on Fox. He spoke with Inside Edition.
title: New Hampshire's Governor Helps Save 'Bob's Burgers' Actor Eugene Mirman From Fiery Car Crash

author: Inside Edition
description: An American tourist alleged that a scuba diving instructor groped her during a lesson. Rasha Mediene, 31, is a social media influencer from Los Angeles who shared her world travels and adventures. The scuba incident happened in Egypt. After the incident, she went on social media to send out a warning. Mediene spoke with Inside Edition's Alison Hall. Inside Edition showed the video to scuba diving columnist Terry Ward.
title: Tourist Alleges Scuba Diving Instructor Groped Her During Lesson

author: Inside Edition
description: With gas prices skyrocketing, California residents are desperate for relief at the pump so they are abandoning their neighborhood gas station in the desert city of Needles and driving across the border to fill up. Cody Eggleston is the manager at the Mobil gas station where gas sells for $7.49 a gallon. Just a mile and a half away, across the border into Arizona's Mojave Valley, drivers are finding gas that sells for $4.19 a gallon, more than $3 a gallon in savings.
title: Some California Drivers Head To Arizona To Fill Up On Gas

title: Human Remains Found In Crocodile In South Africa #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: For many high schoolers, it's a ritual that's become part of the rite of passage of prom: the 'promposal.' Some promposal videos go viral for their creativity, their elaborate staging, their heartwarming reactions. Others go viral for less fortunate reasons. Such is the case for one recent funny promposal in Queens, New York, in which giant letters got mixed up. But never fear: Inside Edition's Alison Hall is giving these teens a chance for a re-do.
title: 'Promposal Fail' Teens Get A Redo

description: The Ramapo College Investigative Genetic Genealogy Center worked with the New Jersey State police to identify human remains found in a shallow grave in Salem County back in 1979.
title: College Students Help Identify Remains In 1979 Cold Case #shorts
